title: DNA binding activity of CAMTA3 is essential for its function: Identification of critical amino acids for its transcriptional activity
authors: Kasavajhala V.S.K. Prasad; Amira Abdel-Hameed; Qiyan Jiang; Anireddy S.N. Reddy
one_liner_zh: 该文通过突变和EMSA实验鉴定CAMTA3转录因子DNA结合关键氨基酸，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属于纯实验验证，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Calmodulin-binding transcription activators (CAMTAs), a small family of highly conserved transcription factors, function in calcium-mediated signaling pathways. Of the six CAMTAs in Arabidopsis, CAMTA3 (also referred to as SR1) regulates diverse biotic and abiotic stress responses. A recent study has shown that CAMTA3 is a guardee of NLR ((nucleotide-binding, leucine-rich repeat domain) immune receptors in modulating plant immunity, thereby suggesting that CAMTA3 transcriptional activity is not necessary for its function. Here, we show that the DNA-binding activity of CAMTA3 is essential for its role in mediating plant immune responses. Analysis of the DNA binding (CG-1) domain of CAMTAs in plants and animals showed strong conservation of several amino acids. We mutated several conserved amino acids in the CG-1 domain to investigate their role in CAMTA3 function. Electrophoretic mobility shift assays using these mutants with a promoter of its target gene identified critical amino acid residues necessary for DNA binding activity. Furthermore, transient assays showed that these residues are essential for the CAMTA3 function in activating the RSRE (Rapid Stress Response Element)-driven reporter gene expression. In line with this, transgenic lines expressing the CG-1 mutants of CAMTA3 in the camta3 mutant failed to rescue the mutant phenotype and restore the expression of CAMTA3 downstream target genes. Collectively, our results provide biochemical and genetic evidence that the transcriptional activity of CAMTA3 is indispensable for its function.
abstract_zh: 钙调素结合转录激活因子（CAMTAs）是一个高度保守的转录因子小家族，在钙介导的信号通路中发挥作用。在拟南芥的六个CAMTA中，CAMTA3（也称为SR1）调控多种生物和非生物胁迫响应。近期一项研究表明，CAMTA3是NLR（核苷酸结合、富含亮氨酸重复结构域）免疫受体的守护者，在调节植物免疫中起作用，从而提示CAMTA3的转录活性对其功能并非必需。在此，我们证明CAMTA3的DNA结合活性对其在介导植物免疫响应中的作用至关重要。对植物和动物中CAMTA的DNA结合（CG-1）结构域的分析显示，多个氨基酸具有强保守性。我们突变了CG-1结构域中的几个保守氨基酸，以研究它们在CAMTA3功能中的作用。使用这些突变体与其靶基因启动子进行的电泳迁移率变动分析，鉴定了对DNA结合活性至关重要的关键氨基酸残基。此外，瞬时实验表明，这些残基对CAMTA3在激活RSRE（快速应激响应元件）驱动的报告基因表达中的功能至关重要。与此一致，在camta3突变体中表达CAMTA3的CG-1突变体的转基因株系未能挽救突变体表型，也未能恢复CAMTA3下游靶基因的表达。综合来看，我们的结果提供了生化和遗传学证据，表明CAMTA3的转录活性对其功能不可或缺。
